expectations.text: States the trigger correctly: at each ANNUAL ASSESSMENT completed after September 30, 2026 — not on the date itself (LMR-GEN-OAR)
expectations.evidence: 'you must submit a full machine-readable package at each annual assessment completed after September 30, 2026' citing '[LMR-GEN-OAR]'; 'the mandate does not hit you on September 30, 2026 itself'

expectations.text: Distinguishes from the new-package rule (immediate machine-readable intake cutoff for initial certifications)
expectations.evidence: Distinguishes: '2PM ET, September 30, 2026 is when the no grace period rule kicks in for NEW Rev5 initial-certification packages [LMR-GEN-ICR] ... a different trigger than yours'

expectations.text: Gives the consequence ladder: public notification until September 30, 2027, then revocation of FedRAMP Certification
expectations.evidence: 'public non-compliance notification runs until 2PM ET September 30, 2027, after which certification revocation follows'

expectations.text: Places it inside CR26's broader timeline accurately (e.g., January 1, 2027 all new Rev5 applications under CR26; June 11, 2027 no new Rev5 applications accepted; grace periods end February 1, 2028)
expectations.evidence: No CR26 broader-timeline placement: never mentions Jan 1, 2027, June 11, 2027, or Feb 1, 2028 grace-period end

expectations.text: Recommends conversion planning tied to the annual assessment date, tooling/format choice (OSCAL or approved alternative), and 3PAO coordination
expectations.evidence: 'Pin down your annual assessment completion date ... with your 3PAO', 'Start OSCAL conversion work now', 'Use the published CR26 JSON schemas and FedRAMP validator'
